4131-5660-6769-8095.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4131-5660-6769-8095.description:
Cast Basalt Monolith by paying its mana cost.
When Basalt Monolith enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Basalt Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Basalt Monolith, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Basalt Monolith from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

394-856-4321-8249.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
394-856-4321-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Desecrated Tomb trigger.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

2103-3554-7164.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Cast Solve the Equation by paying its mana cost, searching your library for Seasons Past and putting into your hand.
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Solve the Equation and Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand and putting Seasons Past onto the bottom of your library.
Repeat.

803-4881-6909-8198.manaNeeded: {4}{B}{G} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
803-4881-6909-8198.description:
Cast Trystan's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

529-3197-4460-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2595-2921-4694-7306.easyPrerequisites: Combine Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
2595-2921-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2595-2921-4694-7306.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-2263-6972.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill 5 cards.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill 5 cards.
Resolve both Grimgrin abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
728-2263-6972.notes: If Geralf's Mindcrusher starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

2558-3490-4659-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
2558-3490-4659-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3899-4871-5220-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
3899-4871-5220-6650.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
3899-4871-5220-6650.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4019-5231-6972.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Vigean Graftmage.
When Vigean Graftmage dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Thermopod ability.
Repeat.

586-864-2921-3125-5632.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2921-3125-5632.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Chalk Outline.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token and Clue token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

223-469.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus the cost of the additional sorcery
223-469.notablePrerequisites: You have an additional castable sorcery.
223-469.description:
Cast any sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Insidious Will by paying its mana cost.
Kalamax's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first ability, creating a copy of Insidious Will and choosing to copy the original Insidious Will.
Resolve the second ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kalamax.
Resolve the Insidious Will copy, creating a copy of Insidious Will.
Kalamax's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 6 any number of times.

4222-6723-7734.description:
Activate Wakandan Tusker by tapping it, adding {U}.
Wakandan Tusker triggers, causing you to scry 1 and gain 1 life
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Wakandan Tusker.
Repeat.

261-5641-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
261-5641-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1169-6738-7011-7082.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more Allies.
1169-6738-7011-7082.description:
Cast Razor Boomerang by paying {0} due to Sokka, Swordmaster.
When Razor Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka and Suki's first ability triggers, attaching Razor Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by tapping it and unattaching Razor Boomerang, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Razor Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3967-5795-6871-6879.description:
Cast Barkform Harvester by paying {3}.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Barkform Harvester.
When Barkform Harvester dies, Haru triggers, returning Barkform Harvester from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 3.

147-3269-6797.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3269-6797.description:
Cast Ascend from Avernus by paying {3}{W}{W}{W}
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Ascend from Avernus.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Ascend from Avernus
Resolve the Ascend from Avernus copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-3269-6797.notes: You can cast Ascend from Avernus for more mana if you wish to return bigger mana value creature or planeswalker cards.

457-5159-5491-6968.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Worldwalker Helm that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature with haste named Mishra's Warform, and a Map token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping a Map, adding {U}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it and a Map token for each Mishra's Warform and/or Worldwalker Helm you control.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two Maps, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
457-5159-5491-6968.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

147-2921-3495.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2921-3495.description:
Cast Breach the Multiverse by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Breach the Multiverse.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Breach the Multiverse, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Breach the Multiverse copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-2921-3495.notes: Breach the Multiverse can put all creature cards from all graveyards and libraries onto the battlefield under your control infinitely. It will also infinitely mill all players.

4375-5147-5400.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Synth Infiltrator enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Synth Infiltrator.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

4338-5256-5929.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Leyline of Transformation, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

586-2438-3375-5258-5618.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3525-3789-6788.manaNeeded: {2}{U} plus enough mana to animate Solar Array if needed
3525-3789-6788.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand with the mana to cast it, including at least one colored mana.
3525-3789-6788.description:
Animate Solar Array, if needed.
Cast Pemmin's Aura by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Solar Array.
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast this turn to have sunburst.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Solar Array.
Repeat from step 3 as desired.
Cast any artifact spell, triggering its sunburst ability an infinite number of times, either putting infinite +1/+1 counters on charge counters on the artifact.
3525-3789-6788.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Solar Array for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.

1353-1497-1768-3327-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1353-1497-1768-3327-4613.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Juniper Order Ranger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and Dargo.
Activate Dargo using Wild Cantor's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

1308-2457-4289-6633.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

1548-2292-3719-6307--85.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least seven creatures, excluding Port Razer, that have total power 1 or greater.
An opponent cannot block and kill Port Razer or Luxurious Locomotive.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
1548-2292-3719-6307--85.description:
Activate Luxurious Locomotive's crew ability by tapping seven creatures you control with total power 1 or greater, causing Luxurious Locomotive to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Luxurious Locomotive and Port Raazer as attackers, triggering Luxurious Locomotive, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Deal combat damage using Port Razer, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Port Razer.
Resolve the Port Razer ability, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing four Treasures, returning Port Razer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

1496-2452-3249-5670--56.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast a Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life equal to the Zombie's toughness.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Zombie, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

930-2034-3781-4973.description:
Cast Universal Automaton from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Universal Automaton, adding {1}.
When Universal Automaton dies, Zask triggers.
Holding priority, cast Universal Automaton from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Resolve the Zask trigger, causing you to mill two cards.
Repeat from step 2.

3967-4871-5433.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure.
3967-4871-5433.description:
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Krenko triggers, causing you to pay {R} to create a 1/1 Goblin creature token with haste.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Goblin token.
When the Goblin dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

922-2067-3858.notablePrerequisites: Your life total plus the number of creatures on the battlefield is equal to or greater than 19.
922-2067-3858.description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}, creating a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
During your next upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain 10 life and win the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

27-647-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
27-647-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror as attackers.
Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2498-4067-4691.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least three.
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2498-4067-4691.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Vilis by paying {B} and two life, targeting any creature.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Sheoldred's first ability triggers twice, causing you to gain four life.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Repeat.

751-1283-2440.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other Drake.
751-1283-2440.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {1}.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Mana Echoes.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {2}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

573-1479-3585.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
573-1479-3585.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it, Greensleeves, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Greensleeves trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
